results.bound: O(logloglog n) rounds; O(n^φ) local memory
results.notes: The paper also discusses a non-uniform polynomial-work implementation with n^φ advice bits depending on n; this is not an ordinary uniform polynomial-time replacement. Aggregate memory is source-reported; the full explicit-list input must be accounted for separately. Total memory: Õ(m+n^(1+φ)). Local work: exp(n^φ) local computation per machine is permitted. This is not a uniform polynomial-local-work guarantee.

results.bound: O(logΔ+loglog n) rounds; O(n^φ) local memory

upsertSlices.label: Near-linear local-memory MPC, degeneracy palette
assumptions: O(n log² n) bits per processor
See the verified figure for per-record palette, total-memory, randomness and local-work scopes.

results.bound: O(1) rounds; n processors × O(n log²n) bits
results.guarantee: κ+o(κ) colors asymptotically; κ+1 in the small-input central branch; With high probability.
results.sourceLocation: ICALP Theorem 12; full version Theorem 4.3 and proof
results.notes: κ≤Δ, but κ+o(κ) is not a numerical substitute for Δ+1. Do not read the little-o notation as exact κ colors for fixed κ. The κ=ω(log²n) restriction belongs to the separate Congested Clique theorem, not this MPC theorem. Total memory: O(n²log²n) bits allocated across n processors (direct product). Local work: The gathered subgraphs are colored locally; the model allows arbitrary local work.
